summary:
Our app may display streaming videos, which require a good internet connection and may not be available at all times.

Digital Original is an immersive art viewer for Meta Quest that transforms how you experience digital and contemporary art.

Unlike traditional virtual galleries, Digital Original is built around presence, quality, and scale. As you move closer to an artwork, you reveal its details — just like in a real exhibition.

Experience art beyond the screen

Enter curated VR spaces or bring artworks
